info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Location Management API
info.description: The Branch Location Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and update information regarding their branch locations. Using this API, developers can create or modify branch data to ensure accurate representation of services in various channels. Typical users include banking operations teams and developers building financial services applications. The API supports seamless integration for managing branch location details, streamlining operations, and enhancing customer access to banking services.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new branch location within the specific channel. You can specify the details necessary for adding the location, ensuring it is correctly associated with the desired channel.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to manage branch locations specific to a channel. It should contain all necessary details required for the operation, such as identifying information and configuration settings.
